_why_this_exists_here: The canonical declaration's deployment_scope is THIS_ORGANIZATION_ONLY_EACH_ORGANIZATION_DEPLOYS_IN_ITS_OWN_DOT_GITHUB. This organization carried no declaration and no exemption register, while carrying surfaces that cannot satisfy the standard. silent_non_conformance_allowed is false, so the absence of the register was itself the non-conformance.

processing_selection._what_the_kernel_gate_does_and_does_not_: org-kernel/kernel.py refuses every boundary_role but BOUNDARY_LOCAL_DIAGNOSTIC and BOUNDARY_LOCAL_CONTROL with endpoint_adapter_not_installed before selection runs, so selection at that surface only ever resolves BOUNDARY_LOCAL_NO_PROCESSOR_SELECTED. The capability/route binding is therefore never enforced by the kernel today, and a passing kernel dispatch must not be read as one. What the kernel gate does achieve is that a manifest declaring a capability at a boundary-local surface now records declared_capability_processed false instead of completing as though the declared capability ran. The binding is enforced at org-boundary/runtime/process_boundary.py, which does resolve INTERNAL_ENDPOINT rows, and will be reached in the kernel when an endpoint adapter is installed.
processing_selection._previous_state: Both dispatch surfaces selected processing by the addressed registry row's boundary_role and endpoint_adapter, referencing neither processing.capability nor processing.route_id. A manifest could declare any capability and the boundary would process it under whichever processor the addressed row named.

canonical_route: StegGhost/entity-sandbox-runner sandbox intake and CGE admission
sandbox_path_invariant._what_is_not_claimed: No leg of this route is addressable at this organization today. The route is architecture of record in the determination cited above; the transport for this organization's legs does not exist. That is registered as an exemption rather than left silent, and this declaration does not imply the route runs.

exemption_path._why_this_register_does_not_open_empty: The canonical register opens empty because that organization had no non-conforming surface to register. This one opens with the surfaces this organization actually carries and cannot yet bind. An empty register here would be the silent non-conformance the rule forbids.
